title: Solder polymorphic OVI
description: A polymorphic OVI (DT-074): the OVIs it groups, its instances, in order, and how a node that calls it looks and picks one. Normative: a .sdp file that does not validate against this schema is not conformant. Read and written by core/model/polymorphic.mjs.

solder-polymorphic.description: The version of the format. A reader MUST refuse a version newer than the one it knows.

instances.description: The instances in order, as the Polymorphic OVI window lists them: Automatic tries them in this order, Select Type ▸ lists them in it, and the first is the one an unwired node calls.

ovi.description: The instance's OVI: a path relative to the .sdp, an absolute one, or a symbolic <ovilib>/… path (DT-073).

menu-name.description: Its name in Select Type ▸ (LabVIEW's Menu Name). Left out, the OVI's file name without its extension.

selector-name.description: The text of the Polymorphic VI Selector ring when this instance is called (LabVIEW's Selector Name). Left out, the menu name.

show-selector-by-default.description: Show Selector by Default: a node placed from this polymorphic OVI shows its selector. Off by default (measured).

adapt-to-data-type.description: Allow Polymorphic OVI to Adapt to Data Type: whether Automatic is offered. On by default (measured).

draw-icon.description: Draw Polymorphic VI Icon (polymorphic) or Draw Instance VI Icon (instance): which icon a node draws.

icon.description: The polymorphic OVI's own 32 × 32 icon, as the text of an SVG document drawn anew for Solder (rule 3). Left out, a generic polymorphic icon.
